location.no_data: No location data yet. Send a locate command with the buttons below!
location.no_push_url: No push URL configured. The device will not receive commands until you set up push notifications in the Android app.

owner.add_device_description: Link an existing FMD account (protocol v2), for example the one of your phone. Its password is used once: your register keeps only the key derived from it, encrypted.
owner.add_tag_description: Creates a new account for a Bluetooth tag. Your phones and laptops report where they see it.
owner.remove_message: The account and its data stay on the server. You can link it again later with its password.
owner.remove_tag_message: The tag account stays on the server, but its password is random: after removing it, nobody can use it any more.
owner.empty_hint: Add a device or a tag to see it on the map.
owner.name: Name
owner.registration_token_hint: Needed once to create tag accounts; it is then stored encrypted in your register. Leave empty if the server has none.
owner.key_rejected: The stored key is rejected (password changed?). Remove the device and link it again.
owner.already_linked: This account is already in your register
owner.v1_account: This account still uses protocol v1. Migrate it first in FMD Android.
